proposals.evidence: DEDR529 explicitly gives Malayalam/Tamil iṟacci and Kodagu eraci flesh/meat. Paniya Irechi preserves the initial vowel and Ravula Rechi lacks it; both preserve the r-plus-affricate shape and exact meat referent. The vowel-less Ravula comparison remains a proposed correspondence, not a source emendation. The alternative Pengo etymology is not used. Das documents multilingual contact; family membership is proposed while inherited versus locally transmitted history remains for review. proposals.evidence: DEDR1458 gives Kodagu kāy- with second stem kāñj- be hot/boil, alongside the southern heating family; 3690 supplies nīr/nīru water. Paniya Kanja Neeru is proposed as heated/boiled plus water. The -a form is compared with the nasal-palatal heated stem without assigning a precise grammatical tag from popular spelling. DEDR nodes denote the full articles; no heading or source spelling is changed.

Paniya Bolle Kallu is tentatively analysed as white plus toddy. The source gloss itself only says Toddy; white is the proposed first-element interpretation, requiring review, not an added source translation.
